locationComparison.name: Deep Wilderness
notes: The Wilderness moss giant spawns (about 6, by the pond reachable using a canoe) are the only spawns that count towards a Krystilia assignment.
Single-combat spawn that is cannonable and has a safespot (single moss giant behind the northernmost tree), useful for low-level Wilderness Slayer; beware player killers.

taskNotes: Moss giants can be assigned by Krystilia only, as a Wilderness task (100-150 per assignment, weight 4); kills must occur in the Wilderness to count.
Krystilia's block cost for a task is 100 Slayer reward points.
Moss giants have 60 Hitpoints and Defence level 30, attack with crush, and carry a 50% Fire weakness.
The Wilderness moss giant spawns sit in the deep Wilderness; carry only what you can afford to lose as this is a PvP area.
The wiki does not document multicombat, cannon, or safespot suitability at the Wilderness spawn, so these flags are left conservatively false (honest UNKNOWN).
The slayerTargetId 266 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract, worklist §1); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
recommendedMethod: Melee the moss giants with any decent weapon in the deep Wilderness; their 50% Fire weakness makes fire spells fastest, but melee is usually preferred to keep risk low in a PvP area. Bring only cheap, expendable gear.
